hunks.before: - name: Require measured capture from the explicitly reviewed virtual input
hunks.after:
- name: Require measured capture from the explicitly reviewed virtual input
        id: selected_capture

hunks.before: - name: Preserve initial native playback and recording diagnostics
hunks.after:
- name: Diagnose only the failed explicitly selected capture input
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.selected_capture.outcome == 'failure' && steps.desktop_runtime.outcome == 'success' && steps.audio_runtime.outcome == 'success' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository == 'Oleksii-debug/AudioTacticalFPS' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/carr/ci-endpoint-evaluation-20261127' }}
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          $ffmpeg = Join-Path $env:CARR_AUDIO_RUNTIME 'bin/ffmpeg.exe'
          & $env:CARR_PYTHON -I -B -X utf8 scripts/windows_capture_access_diagnostic.py --ffmpeg $ffmpeg --capture-report 'ci-results/native-recording-device.json' --report 'ci-results/recording-access-diagnostic.json' 2>&1 | Tee-Object 'ci-results/recording-access-diagnostic.txt'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Preserve initial native playback and recording diagnostics
